inputs.text: An Indiana judge has blocked a law restricting abortion after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued that it burdens religious freedom. This is about more than legal wording: when lawmakers impose one moral or religious outlook on everyone, the people who need reproductive care pay the price. Religious liberty should protect people’s freedom to make deeply personal decisions—not give the state power to enforce a single view of morality.
